research_question: What overhead does runtime DLL discovery add to the tested ingestion pipeline relative to statically compiled registration?
dataset_role: development public data; deterministic replay workload; holdout excluded from tuning and performance workloads
independent_unit: fresh operating-system process; two adjacent executions form a randomized treatment pair
ordering: fixed-seed randomized condition/block order, and randomized dynamic/static order within each pair
backend: same local SQLite implementation, transaction policy, validation, parser source, and readback logic
measurement_scope: whole-process wall time and Host-reported ingestion time; input preparation excluded; startup/discovery included in process wall time
latency_unit: one file through parse/validate/transaction/readback; 12 files per run; within-run P50/P95/P99 are descriptive
inference_boundary: single nonexclusive host, controlled structured CSV workload, 12 fixed replay files, cache not flushed, no production or saturation claim
